start: Member app, plan card; a gym plan that has not ended

steps.action: Tap 'Pause my plan', pick a start (today or within 90 days) and an end, send
user_sees: The request shows as waiting for the desk
must_not: The plan's end date moved before the desk approves

steps.action: The desk approves
user_sees: The plan card shows the approved pause and the new end date from the gym's record
must_not: A new end date taken from the phone
The answer missing until the app is reinstalled

steps.action: Tap 'Renew my plan', pick one of the gym's plans, send
user_sees: The renewal shows as waiting; when approved, the new plan dates and that it is paid at the desk
must_not: A PT pack offered as a plan
The renewal shown as paid

steps.action: Ask to pause from yesterday, or more than 90 days ahead, or for more than 365 days
user_sees: Refused: BAD_DATES (app words unknown)
must_not: A pause request saved with wrong dates

steps.action: Ask a second pause while one waits
user_sees: Refused: ALREADY_ASKED
must_not: Two waiting pause requests

steps.action: A 7th request in one day, or a pause with no running plan
user_sees: Refused: TOO_MANY or NO_PLAN
must_not: The request sent anyway

start: A pause request waiting for the desk

steps.action: Take it back
user_sees: The request is gone
must_not: The desk still approving a request taken back

steps.action: After the desk answers, read the answer
user_sees: The answer stops showing once seen
must_not: An answer that keeps coming back after it was seen
Taking back an answered request

start: A member whose check-in number is shared with a family member

steps.action: Open the plan card's request buttons
user_sees: A plain refusal (SHARED_NUMBER) and nothing of the plan shown
must_not: Another family member's plan or requests shown

steps.action: A matched member opens requests
user_sees: Only their own requests
must_not: Another member's requests

start: Admin app, the requests list; a member asked to pause

steps.action: Open the request (member's name from the gym's list)
user_sees: Name, dates asked, and buttons to approve or decline
must_not: A request of another gym
'A member' when the gym's list has the name

steps.action: Approve: the panel runs 'Freeze / extra days' for those dates, then marks it approved
user_sees: The request approved, with the plan's new end date
must_not: The request approved without the plan changed (NOT_DONE is the refusal)
The end date moved twice

steps.action: Approve a request whose freeze or sale was not written
user_sees: Refused (NOT_DONE)
must_not: Approved with no plan change

steps.action: Decline a request another desk already approved
user_sees: Refused (ALREADY_DECIDED)
must_not: The approval overwritten by a decline

start: A request waiting in the list

steps.action: Decline it
user_sees: Declined, with who decided and when
must_not: The plan changed by a decline

steps.action: Press decline again (a lost answer)
user_sees: The same answer, nothing doubles
must_not: An error for a repeat of the same answer
